concept.central_question: Do smart people fall for scams?
concept.claim: Smart people fall for scams because calm authority beats intelligence.

scenes.narration: Some people say smart people never fall for scams. Is that true?
scenes.graphic: Myth: Smart people never fall for scams | Researchers say intelligence is not armour

scenes.narration: According to UK Finance, around four hundred and fifty million pounds were lost to these scams in 2024.
scenes.graphic: Counter: £0 → £450m | lost to bank-transfer scams, UK 2024 | according to UK Finance

scenes.narration: Researchers believe the call climbs one small step at a time.
scenes.graphic: Staircase: The safety line; The small yes; The secret; The transfer | How the call climbs

scenes.narration: Researchers argue that by the end, stopping feels heavier than going on.
scenes.graphic: Scale: minutes, small yeses, pride | admitting it | too heavy to drop

scenes.narration: The money moves across the map in minutes, researchers say.
scenes.graphic: Pinmap: London | A transfer in minutes | test reel

scenes.narration: So, hang up and call back. That is the whole trick, researchers suggest.
